# RichTextAnchorLink

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.RichTextAnchorLink`

## Documentation

A link to an anchor in the same message.

### Parameters

- **`text`** ([`RichText`](RichText.md))
  The link text.

- **`anchor_name`** (`str`)
  The anchor name. If the name is empty, the link must bring back to top.

- **`url`** (`str`, *optional*)
  A URL that opens the anchor. Ignored when sending.
